title: Ngong Ping cable car, Big Buddha, then the city
summary: Out to Lantau for the first cable car, back to the Island for lunch and the Sheung Wan shops, a rest at the hotel, then Temple Street at night.

rows.detail: Crystal cabin, Klook voucher (How-to 20). First car, shortest queues. 25 minutes.

rows.what: Big Buddha, Po Lin Monastery, Wisdom Path
rows.detail: 268 steps up. Skip most of the village.

rows.what: Train to Hong Kong Station, Central
Lunch in Central or Sheung Wan
rows.detail: Yum cha is Friday's lunch, so eat whatever appeals here.
Hollywood Road, Cat Street antiques, vintage and resale. Don't forget Man Mo Temple, on Hollywood Road as you pass. Ten minutes inside.

rows.what: Star Ferry from Central to Tsim Sha Tsui
rows.detail: On the water close to sunset, about 17:50.
Friday is the plan. If you go tonight instead: quick change first, short taxi to ICC, and Friday evening is free.

rows.what: Temple Street dinner and night market
rows.detail: Claypot rice or street-side seafood, then browse the stalls. A 15 minute walk from the hotel.
